title: Instruction intake register
description: One register file per repository. Records what happened to each agent instruction artifact found in that repository. Append-only: a record may gain a later entry, it may not disappear. The normative protocol is standards/workspace/instruction-intake.md.

repository.description: Repository identifier, matching an entry in the Instance repository inventory. The register does not record a path: paths are inventory data and would drift here.

records.description: Entries for one artifact form a history ordered by recorded_at; the last one is current.

artifact.description: Path relative to the repository root.

region.description: Identifier of a declared region inside a container file, exactly as it appears in that region's marker (instruction-intake.md §3.1). Required when delivery is agents-md-section: a container holds several subjects, and one topic assigned to the whole file would be false about most of it. When a record carries a region, its digest is the digest of the region's text, not of the file.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the artifact at intake time. Without it the record describes an unknown text.

delivery.description: Packaging the tool loads the norm from. Same vocabulary as agent-instruction-identity.md §5; a register that named it differently would be the drift this system is built to catch.

topic.description: Topic name from the registry, or "unclassified".

genre.description: Document type pool of standards/workspace/document-identity.md. "skill" is deliberately absent: packaging is delivery, not genre.

profile.description: Stack profile the norm belongs to. Required when scope is profile.

observed_activation.description: How the norm reaches the context today, not how it should. "undetermined" is a finding, not a blank.

derived_from.description: Qualified reference to the parent edition. A bare path is not a reference: it resolves to a different text in every checkout and at every moment, so the record could never be re-checked by anyone but its author.

repository.description: Repository identifier from the Instance inventory, or "kernel" for the Meridian Kernel itself.

path.description: Path relative to that repository's root.

revision.description: The revision the edition was taken from. The digest below is the digest of the parent at this revision, not of the parent today: a parent that has since moved on makes the edition stale, not the record false.

narrowing.description: What this edition removes or replaces relative to its parent. An edition without it is indistinguishable from an independent text on the same topic.

successor.description: Where the content of a retired norm went.

retire_reason.description: Why the content no longer holds. Retiring requires this or a successor; neither is not brevity, it is a defective record.

core_lines.description: What entered the topic core. Produced when the verdict is carried out, not when it is recorded.

allOf.comment: A container record names a region — except in the one case the protocol names: a container that declares no region boundaries at all, which §3.1 requires to be recorded as a single deferred entry. Without this exception that record was unrepresentable: the schema demanded a region name the file does not have, so the protocols own answer for an unmarked container could only be written by misdeclaring its delivery.
